Title: Instance size flexibility for Azure Reserve Virtual Machine Instances now available

Body.Content:
Instance size flexibility for Azure Reserve Virtual Machine Instances is a new feature now available for all new and existing Azure RI purchases. Instance size flexibility can:

·        Simplify the management of Azure Reserved VM Instances.

·        Avoid the need to exchange or cancel your Azure RI to apply its benefit to other virtual machines within the same Azure RI VM group and region.

·        Automatically apply Azure RI benefits that you have purchased to other VMs within the same group and region.

·        Help you further reduce your costs in many scenarios.

This new feature applies to both Windows and Linux Azure Virtual Machines.

Learn more.
